title: 第82章 一个扔了的号码能查到什么？

第82章 一个扔了的号码能查到什么？-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

整整半个小时过去了。

顾承安盯着手机屏幕上那个转了快一圈又一圈的加载图标，忽然对这套号称“全国最先进”的高阶追踪系统产生了一丝怀疑。

说好的高阶呢？说好的全域呢？

跑个数据跟老太太过马路似的，他都快睡着了。

正想着要不要去泡杯茶，屏幕一闪，结果终于弹了出来。

【检索完成，共匹配相关条目：47条。】

四十七条。

系统没有区分原图和伪装图，而是把所有达到阈值的结果统一按相似度从高到低排了出来，顾承安坐直身子，开始逐条翻看。

第一条，相似度94.2%，鹏城南山区某路口，时间戳显示是三天前下午两点十七分，画面里一个戴鸭舌帽的男人从便利店出来，手里拎着一个塑料袋，低着头快步走过镜头。

体态、肩宽、步幅——是瘦猴。

第二条，相似度91.8%，同样是鹏城，福田区某地下通道入口，五天前，这次没戴帽子，但架了副黑框眼镜，头发往后梳了，看着像个中年程序员。

还是他。

顾承安继续往下翻。

第三条到第七条，全是无关人员，有个外卖小哥因为脸型相似被系统拉了进来，还有个大学生、一个菜市场卖鱼的大叔、两个路过的中年男人。

系统再先进，也不可能百分百精准，毕竟是从海量监控数据里逐帧比对，总会有误判。

顾承安耐着性子一条条筛。

四十七条数据，他花了二十分钟全部过完。

最终结论：有效条目十二条，其中瑞丽地区三条，鹏城境内八条，还有一条是在天堂山服务区拍到的，应该是憋不住上厕所拍到的。

时间是二十天前——大概率是瘦猴从滇省来鹏城的中转途中。

鹏城的八条里，案发现场周边占了两条。

顾承安点开这两条的详细信息。

第一条：案发当天下午六点三十三分，距离饭店约两百米的一个公交站台，瘦猴戴着口罩坐在候车椅上，目光方向正对着饭店入口。

第二条：同一天下午八点零二分，同一个公交站台，瘦猴起身离开，往东走，消失在监控盲区。

Chapter 82 What can be found from a thrown away number?- "The system sends editors, from a deliveryman to a 007 agent"

A full half hour passed.

Gu Chengan stared at the loading icon that was spinning around on the screen of his mobile phone, and suddenly he had a doubt about this high-end tracking system, which was known as "the most advanced in the country".

What about the high-level ones you promised?What about the whole area that was promised?

Running data was like crossing the street with an old lady, he almost fell asleep.

Just as I was thinking about making a cup of tea, the screen flashed and the result finally popped up.

[Search completed, total matching related entries: 47.】

Article 47.

The system did not distinguish between the original pictures and the disguised pictures. Instead, it ranked all the results that reached the threshold in order of similarity from high to low. Gu Chengan sat up straight and began to look through them one by one.

The first one, with a similarity of 94.2%, is at an intersection in Nanshan District, Pengcheng. The timestamp shows that it was 2:17 pm three days ago. In the picture, a man wearing a peaked cap came out of a convenience store, holding a plastic bag in his hand and walking quickly past the camera with his head lowered.

Body posture, shoulder width, stride length - it's a thin monkey.

The second article, with a similarity of 91.8%, is also from Pengcheng, the entrance to an underground passage in Futian District, five days ago. This time, he was not wearing a hat, but he was wearing a pair of black-rimmed glasses and his hair was combed back. He looked like a middle-aged programmer.

It's still him.

Gu Chengan continued to scroll down.

The third to seventh items are all unrelated people. There is a delivery boy who was pulled in by the system because of a similar face shape, a college student, an uncle selling fish in the market, and two middle-aged men passing by.

No matter how advanced the system is, it cannot be 100% accurate. After all, it is comparing frame by frame from massive monitoring data, so there will always be misjudgments.

Gu Chengan patiently sifted through everything.

It took him twenty minutes to go through all the forty-seven pieces of data.

Final conclusion: There are twelve valid entries, including three in Ruili area, eight in Pengcheng, and one was taken in the Tiantang Mountain service area. It should be taken when he couldn't hold back and went to the toilet.

The time was twenty days ago - most likely Shouhou was on his way to Pengcheng from Dian Province.

Of the eight in Pengcheng, two were around the crime scene.

Gu Chengan clicked on the detailed information of these two items.

Article 1: At 6:33 pm on the day of the incident, at a bus stop about 200 meters away from the hotel, Shouhou was sitting on a waiting chair wearing a mask, looking directly at the entrance of the hotel.

Article 2: At 8:02 pm on the same day, at the same bus stop, Shouhou got up and left, walked east, and disappeared into the blind spot of the surveillance.
